title: Chapter 216: I Have a Bad Feeling
html:
“Boss, you look energetic this morning.” Xu Wan arrived to find Chen Ge arguing with the white cat perched atop the tree. The sight no longer surprised her.

“Xiao Wan, put on your makeup. Tian Teng Medical School’s staff are visiting for a professional exchange. You’re my only presentable employee, so I’m counting on you.”

“Okay.” Xu Wan pointed at the white cat munching on Chen Ge’s jacket. “Do you need my help?”

“It’s fine. I can handle one cat.”

That morning, Chen Ge had gathered his laundry. While his attention wandered, the white cat dragged the jacket once used to wrap the kittens up the tree. “I’m not washing that one! Please come down!”

New Century Park opened at 9 a.m., and nearly half the arriving visitors headed straight for the Haunted House. “There are even more people than yesterday.”

Chen Ge’s Haunted House was by far the most popular attraction.

“Boss Chen!” Familiar faces led the crowd. Chen Ge brightened at the sight of them, making Tian Teng Medical School’s owner shiver involuntarily. He coughed and lowered his gaze. “We brought several colleagues from the industry. Everyone would like to experience your Haunted House.”

The owner winked pointedly. They had brought friends and fans; he hoped Chen Ge would preserve their dignity. “Colleagues from the industry?”

Chen Ge surveyed the group. Apart from Tian Teng’s actors, the others did not look as though they had come merely for entertainment.

“Allow me to introduce everyone. This is Han Qiuming, the district’s finest Haunted House designer. He has collaborated with international teams and designed Tian Teng Medical School. He was overseas when you visited.” The owner stepped aside, revealing a tall, thin man with thick glasses and an aloof expression.

“The short-haired woman beside him is Ye Xiaoxin, a prominent blogger with more than six hundred thousand followers. She reviews Haunted Houses and has visited over fifty nationwide.” The owner’s expression stiffened. “When she heard about you, she contacted me and asked to join us.”

“Nice to meet you.” Barely over twenty, Ye Xiaoxin had fair skin and stood about 1.74 meters tall. Her long legs drew attention, while her cropped hair and androgynous style gave her a handsome appearance. Watching someone like her explore Haunted Houses alone explained her enormous following.

“Boss Chen, don’t underestimate her.” The owner seemed to have suffered at her hands before. “Her tolerance for fear is exceptional. On her first visit to Tian Teng, she played cruel pranks on our actors. Unfortunately, she has no sense of direction and needed us to guide her out after wandering for forty minutes.”

“Wonderful. I admire courageous people.” Many women claimed fearlessness before entering, Gao Ru Xue among them. Chen Ge smiled kindly while wondering how his Haunted House had treated such confidence in the past.

“If you have no objection, then good.” Seeing Chen Ge remain unfazed, Tian Teng’s owner beckoned. “Come over. We should prepare to enter.”

Three more people emerged from the crowd—two men and a woman. Chen Ge recognized the woman from the queue at Tian Teng Medical School. Her sweet face gave her a friendly, girl-next-door appearance.

She walked forward to greet Chen Ge. “Do you still remember me? We met each other in the elevator at Tian Teng Medical School. My name is Su Luoluo.”

“Luoluo is a well-known Haunted House enthusiast. She won a drawing to experience your attraction with us,” the owner explained awkwardly. In truth, his employees had refused to come, forcing him to fill the group through a supposed fan “drawing.”

“Is that so? Then she’s certainly ‘lucky.’” Sunlight warmed Chen Ge’s gentle smile. Su Luoluo glanced at him, then lowered her face in embarrassment.

“You’ve met the other two. They work at my Haunted House.” The owner pointed to the men in back. “The large one is Song An, who played the security ghost. The smaller is Du Chaojin, who hid inside the steel box.”

Because Chen Ge had not “attacked” Song An, the man greeted him politely. Du Chaojin reacted differently. While hiding in the steel box to scare Chen Ge, he had heard Wedding Dress begin behind him. Worse, Chen Ge blocked the exit, trapping him inside until his desperate screams earned his release. He had crawled out looking half-dead.

Meeting his “nemesis” again drained the color from Du Chaojin’s face. Without makeup, he looked no older than eighteen—thin, youthful, and probably employed part-time. “I barely recognized you. Who would have guessed you were the patient screaming to be let out of the box?”

Before Xiao Du could erupt, the owner hurriedly pulled Chen Ge aside. “Boss Chen, six of us will enter together. We’ll follow your arrangements.”

Facing away from the others, the owner winked repeatedly. Chen Ge understood. “The Haunted House currently has four scenarios: Minghun, Murder by Midnight, Mu Yang High School, and the new Third Sick Hall. The first two are Normal difficulty, while the Third Sick Hall is the hardest. I recommend the intermediate Mu Yang High School.”

“Alright, we’ll visit that one.” The proprietor nodded, but the people behind him had things to say.

“That’s rather dishonest.” Han Qiuming adjusted his thick glasses. “We asked around before coming. Everyone says Mu Yang High School is your hardest scenario and remains unbeaten. Passing it off as intermediate is excessive, don’t you think?”

“I’m being unkind?”

“Are you afraid we’ll clear your hardest scenario and embarrass you? Is that why you invented one supposedly more difficult?” Han Qiuming smirked. “A large themed scenario takes months to design. Mu Yang High School opened less than a week ago. When could you possibly have built another?”

His thin lips curled higher. “It doesn’t matter. We came to clear every scenario you have.”

“Qiuming, don’t be absurd. Boss Chen isn’t that kind of man.” The owner tugged at his arm as dread surfaced. Chen Ge listened without arguing. Uncle Xu had taught him that a theme-park employee should always strive to satisfy a visitor’s wishes.

After a moment’s thought, Chen Ge smiled again. “In that case, begin with the Third Sick Hall. If you can still walk afterward, we’ll continue to Mu Yang High School.”
